# Bold Restaurant Ghana

> Bold is a rooftop restaurant and bar at 12 Obenesu Cres, Accra, Ghana. It serves brunch, lunch, dinner, sushi, cocktails and late-night food, with rooftop and outdoor seating. Rated 4.3 from 206 Google reviews.

## Key facts
- Address: 12 Obenesu Cres, Accra, Ghana
- Opening hours: daily, 12 pm to 12 am
- Phone and WhatsApp (reservations): +233 54 077 7007
- Reservations: accepted; brunch reservations recommended
- Seating: rooftop, outdoor and indoor; dine-in and takeaway (no delivery)
- Parking: free parking lot and free street parking
- Dietary: halal food, vegetarian and vegan options, kids' menu
- Good for: groups, kids and kids' birthdays, solo dining, tourists
- Accessibility: wheelchair-accessible seating and toilet
- Payments: credit cards, debit cards, NFC mobile payments
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/boldghana/

## Pages
- [Home](https://bold-restaurant-ghana.vercel.app/): overview, photos, FAQ, location and opening hours

## Menu highlights

### To Start
- Korean Chicken Wings: Fresh chicken wings with our special Korean mix, sprinkled with spring onions, sesame and ginger.
- Salmon Tartare: Fresh salmon stacked with pickled radish, beetroot and caviar, seasoned with avocado cream.
- Goat Cheese Salad: Fried goat cheese balls, arugula, walnuts, croutons, mushroom slices and balsamic dressing.
- Salmon Ceviche

### From the Sushi Bar
- Sushi Platter: An assortment of rolls with tuna, salmon, avocado and crisp toppings, served with ginger and wasabi.

### Mains
- Seared Fish: Crisp-skinned fish served over a green purée.
- Wagyu Burger
- Pizza

### Bread & Sweet
- Bread
- Coconut Cotta

### Drinks
- Cocktails: Great cocktails, poured at our bar.
- Wine: A great wine list.
- Beer & Spirits: A great beer selection, with spirits at the bar.
- Coffee & Tea: Great coffee and tea selection.

## Notes
- The menu on the site is a selection; prices and availability are given by the restaurant.
